==Usage== 
{{Patchbox
|Title      = 
|Patchname  = 
|Image      = 
|Caption    = 
|Announced  =
|Release    = 
|Latest     = 
|Version    = 
|Latestv    = 
|toc        = 
|Highlights = 
|Related    = 
|Prev       = 
|Current    = 
|Next       = 
}}
The command /dump GetBuildInfo() may be helpful for getting the various version numbers. ==Parameters== {| class="wikitable" style="width: 40%;" ! Parameter ! Status ! Description |- | Patchname | required | patch subtitle, if exists |- | Image | optional | Full image code, 256px width suggested |- | Caption | optional | Image caption |- | Announced | optional | Date of announcement. Include a link to the announcement/archived version |- | Release | required | The date it was released on live servers. |- | Latest | optional | latest date the patch received an update, typically a hotfix |- | Version | required | initial release code version, e.g. [[Public client builds]] |- | Latestv | optional | latest release build since the initial |- | toc | required | Addon toc version |- | Highlights | optional | Brief list of highlights |- | Related | optional | List related links |- | Prev | required | Previous patch NUMBER |- | Current | optional | Current patch NUMBER |- | Next | required | Next patch NUMBER |} [[Category:Infobox templates|Patchbox]][[Category:Template documentation|{{PAGENAME}}]]
